falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes below $92,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A close below $92,000 would break the higher-low structure that defines the current breakout pattern, indicating the December 2020-style continuation thesis is invalid and the market is instead rolling over into a deeper correction or trend reversal.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on major perpetual swaps (Binance/OKX) turns negative for 3 consecutive 8-hour intervals
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent negative funding would signal that leveraged longs have been fully flushed and shorts are now dominant, contradicting the blowoff/continuation setup which requires sustained bullish positioning and premium funding to drive the next leg up.

falsification_conditions.condition: Spot ETF net outflows exceed $500M in a single trading day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A single-day outflow of that magnitude would demonstrate institutional distribution rather than accumulation, directly falsifying the premise that this is a 2020-style breakout driven by new institutional demand absorbing supply.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
